actions.create_monitor.description: Create a new HTTP uptime monitor in UptimeRobot
actions.create_monitor.props.friendly_na: A name for this monitor (e.g. 'Company Website' or 'API Server')
actions.create_monitor.props.interval.de: How often UptimeRobot checks this URL, in seconds. Minimum 300s (5 min) on the Free plan, 60s on Solo/Team, 30s on Enterprise.
actions.create_monitor.props.url.descrip: The full URL to monitor, including the protocol (e.g. 'https://example.com').
actions.delete_monitor.description: Permanently delete a monitor from UptimeRobot. This cannot be undone.
actions.delete_monitor.props.monitor.des: Select the monitor to act on, or leave blank and use "Monitor ID" below to pass a dynamic value.
actions.delete_monitor.props.monitor_id_: Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID from a previous step. If set, this overrides the dropdown selection above.
actions.edit_monitor.description: Update the settings of an existing UptimeRobot monitor
actions.edit_monitor.props.friendly_name: Update the monitor's name. Leave empty to keep the current name.
actions.edit_monitor.props.interval.desc: Minimum 300s (5 min) on the Free plan, 60s on Solo/Team, 30s on Enterprise. Values below the plan minimum are rejected by UptimeRobot. Leave empty to keep the current interval.
actions.edit_monitor.props.monitor.descr: Select the monitor to act on, or leave blank and use "Monitor ID" below to pass a dynamic value.
actions.edit_monitor.props.monitor_id_ov: Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID from a previous step (e.g. {{create_monitor.id}}). If set, this overrides the dropdown selection above.
actions.edit_monitor.props.url.descripti: Update the URL or IP being monitored. Leave empty to keep the current value.
actions.get_monitors.description: List and search your UptimeRobot monitors with optional filters. Leave the Monitors / Monitor IDs fields empty to return all monitors.
actions.get_monitors.props.monitor_ids.d: Filter to specific monitors. Leave empty to include all monitors in your account.
actions.get_monitors.props.monitor_ids_c: Use this to pass dynamic Monitor IDs from a previous step (e.g. "123, 456"). Merged with any selections above.
actions.get_monitors.props.status.descri: Only return monitors with this status. Leave empty for all statuses.
actions.get_monitors.props.type.descript: Only HTTP monitors are supported at the moment. Other UptimeRobot types (Keyword, Ping, Port, Heartbeat) will be added in a future release. Leave empty to return monitors of all types.
actions.pause_resume_monitor.description: Temporarily pause or resume monitoring for a specific monitor.
actions.pause_resume_monitor.props.actio: Pause stops all checks and alerts. Resume restarts monitoring.
actions.pause_resume_monitor.props.monit: Select the monitor to act on, or leave blank and use "Monitor ID" below to pass a dynamic value.
Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID from a previous step. If set, this overrides the dropdown selection above.
auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to your [UptimeRobot Dashboard](https://dashboard.uptimerobot.com/)
2. Click **Integrations & API** in the left sidebar
3. Scroll to the **API** section
4. Click **Show** next to your Main API Key
5. Copy the key and paste it here

The key starts with `u` followed by a long string of numbers and letters.

**Note:** Free plans are limited to 10 API requests per minute. Paid plans support up to 5,000 req/min.
